events.name: ChatGPT said: heading level 4 Use this prompt with Antigravity: Copy We have a new accessibility-analysis result. Do NOT make site-specific fixes or hardcode logic for this website. Our analyzer must remain completely generic and website-independent. I want you to REVIEW AND IMPROVE THE ANALYZER'S REASONING PIPELINE based on the latest result. Latest result currently contains: - AI-001: “Click to Visit” links → WCAG 2.4.4, MAJOR - AI-002: University logo missing alternative text → WCAG 1.1.1 - Recommendations: 1. Missing main landmark 2. Heading structure 3. Decorative/new.gif images - Score: 92.9% The most important task is AI-001. ================================================== 1. RE-EVALUATE AI-001 — “CLICK TO VISIT” ================================================== Do NOT simply assume: same link text + different href = WCAG 2.4.4 violation The analyzer must reason about LINK PURPOSE USING CONTEXT. The evidence package contains contextual headings/groups such as: - Letters & Notices - Application & Notice - New Syllabus - Teacher Appointment - Admit Card - Examination Routine and links whose visible text is repeatedly: - “Click to Visit” - “Apply Now” The analyzer must determine whether the purpose of each link is sufficiently determinable from: - link accessible name - surrounding DOM text - nearest heading - parent/container context - associated section/group - href/destination where useful - visual evidence - NVDA output - interaction/synchronization evidence Do not use a hardcoded list of headings, link labels, selectors, CSS paths, or website-specific rules. The generic reasoning should be approximately: 1. Identify ambiguous/repeated link text. 2. Gather programmatically determinable context for each link. 3. Determine whether that context distinguishes the purpose of the link. 4. Consider what a screen-reader user actually receives. 5. Only classify it as WCAG 2.4.4 if the available context still does NOT make the purpose determinable. 6. Otherwise classify it as a recommendation/advisory, or do not report a problem. IMPORTANT: “Click to Visit” being generic is NOT by itself sufficient evidence of a WCAG violation if the surrounding context programmatically determines the destination/purpose. The model must explain WHY the context is or is not sufficient. ================================================== 2. RE-EVALUATE AI-002 — IMAGE ALTERNATIVE TEXT ================================================== Keep the finding only if the evidence supports an actual WCAG 1.1.1 failure. For every meaningful image with missing alt text, the AI must first consider: - Is the image decorative? - Is equivalent information already provided by adjacent/associated text? - Is the image conveying information/function? - Is it part of branding/logo content? - Is it inside a link, and if so, what is the accessible name of that link? - Does the visual evidence indicate meaningful information that is otherwise unavailable? Do not automatically classify every missing alt attribute as a WCAG violation. Again, this must be generic and evidence-driven. ================================================== 3. FIX THE NORMATIVE BASIS STRUCTURE ================================================== The current output has a malformed structure where multiple pieces of information are being placed inside: "success criterion" For example, the generated value is effectively combining: - criterion - level - failure condition - evidence basis inside one string. Fix the schema so it is structurally separated. Use a structure similar to: "normative basis": { "success criterion": "2.4.4", "level": "A", "requirement": "...", "failure condition": "...", "evidence basis": [ "DOM", "NVDA", "VISUAL", "INTERACTION" ] } Do not blindly copy this exact structure if the existing architecture has a better equivalent. The important requirement is that these fields remain independently machine-readable. Also ensure: - success criterion contains ONLY the WCAG SC number. - level contains ONLY A / AA / AAA. - requirement contains the normative requirement. - failure condition contains the specific observed failure. - evidence basis contains the actual evidence modalities used. - Do not fabricate evidence modalities that were not actually available/used. ================================================== 4. PRESERVE VIOLATION vs RECOMMENDATION SEPARATION ================================================== Keep the architecture introduced in the previous iteration: violations recommendations Rules: VIOLATIONS: Only confirmed normative WCAG Success Criterion failures. RECOMMENDATIONS: Best practices, semantic improvements, maintainability suggestions, structural improvements, or issues where the evidence is insufficient to establish a WCAG failure. Do NOT promote a recommendation into a violation simply because: - a preferred HTML element is missing - a preferred heading structure is missing - a preferred ARIA landmark is missing - a link text is generic - an alt attribute is missing The AI must establish the actual WCAG failure condition. ================================================== 5. SCORING ================================================== Keep recommendations at ZERO score deduction. Only confirmed normative violations should affect the accessibility score. events.name: I have created the implementation plan to resolve the pre-traversal NVDA
events.value: speech bug and establish causal, boundary-marked traversal synchronization. Please review the plan in implementation plan.md. Key Architectural Highlights Root Cause Verified: NVDA's native browse-mode page-load announcements (and default "Automatic Say All on Page Load") accumulate in the Speech Viewer buffer while the page loads and when body.click() is triggered. Because the buffer was not drained before traversal, Step 1 swept up the entire document's speech, causing widespread matcher desynchronization. Explicit Lifecycle State Model: Implements INITIALIZING → PAGELOADING → PAGELOADSPEECH → NVDACAPTUREREADY → BASELINEESTABLISHED → TRAVERSALREADY → TRAVERSING → TRAVERSALCOMPLETE. Pre-Traversal Speech Preservation: Initial page speech is isolated and preserved under a top-level initialization metadata block, completely protecting forward and backward traversal elements from contamination. Causal Traversal Boundary: Each step records a pre-action buffer mark, fires the traversal action, and waits for fresh speech strictly after the mark. Timeouts are recorded as NVDACAPTURETIMEOUT without false unlabelled classifications. 13 Comprehensive Automated Test Cases: Covering asynchronous speech, delayed arrival, timeouts, dynamic DOM, and zero website-specific rules. Please review the plan and approve it when you're ready to proceed to execution.
